assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: DOSO robotics mobile app hero-card artwork, standalone production asset with a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Input image 1 is a SUBJECT REFERENCE: the existing DOSO wheel-legged quadruped marketing render. Preserve its recognizable elongated white chassis, dark inset panels, large circular joints, four articulated legs, and four black wheels. This is an illustrative app asset, not an engineering diagram.
Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow the softly lit, pale luminous, translucent sculptural materials of the colorful artwork inside the cards. Do not copy any text, page, card border, buttons, prices, or layout chrome.
Create one refined three-quarter front-side studio rendering of the referenced DOSO wheel-legged robot, facing left. The robot is the clear subject; retain physical plausibility and exactly four wheels. Light warm-white ceramic shells and brushed light titanium, charcoal joints, subtle cool blue highlights. A single delicate broad iridescent ribbon, pastel cyan shading to lilac, curves BEHIND the robot, never obscuring legs or silhouette. Keep overall industrial appearance restrained, elegant and adult, not toy-like. Broad softbox lighting, gentle reflections, exceptionally clean antialiased edges, subtle contact shadow that fades fully into transparency. Avoid a rectangular background, floor horizon, pedestal, decorative symbols, particles, neon glow, UI elements, and extra accessories. Do not add writing; preserve only the existing small DOSO wordmark if it remains legible.
Wide landscape composition, approximately 3:2. Place robot and ribbon entirely in the right 65% of the canvas, with generous empty TRANSPARENT space on the left for real app text. Keep every wheel within frame and generous breathing room at right/top/bottom. The artwork must integrate naturally into a white or #F5F5F5 card. Output a single high-resolution RGBA asset, not a collage or mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone 3D artwork for the REMOTE CONTROL feature card in the DOSO robot app. This is image material only, no interface.
Reference image: use only the softly luminous sculptural art direction inside the cards, the restrained palette, softly rounded shapes, broad studio lighting and fine translucent resin surfaces. Do not reproduce the UI, typography, or any frame.
Primary subject: one beautifully crafted physical thumb joystick, angled in three-quarter view, a short stem carrying a broad rounded circular cap, seated in a shallow circular control ring. This should immediately read as a joystick for precision movement, not a gamepad. White satin ceramic base, thick translucent sky-blue and azure optical-resin cap with a fine luminous edge, delicate cyan refraction, a subtle raised circular ring. Three simple solid volumes only; clean readable silhouette even when small. The outer circular ring is slightly offset in perspective to convey an input direction, no arrows or symbols. Extremely refined tactile product illustration, generous roundovers, soft ambient occlusion and one delicate diffused contact shadow. Bright softbox lighting from top left. Match a premium calm white mobile interface. No chrome glare, no dark background, no neon, no sparkles, no labels, no text, no border or card, no pedestal.
Square canvas. Joystick fully visible, centered horizontally in the UPPER 65% of the image, occupying about 72% width with margins; the bottom 28% is empty fully transparent negative space for real app text. All shadows must fade completely into alpha. Genuinely transparent background. Output one crisp high-resolution RGBA art asset, not a mockup or a collage.

A round hip joint at upper-left connects to a curved satin-ceramic upper link, a round blush-pink translucent knee joint, then a shorter ceramic lower link ending in one small dark-neutral rubber wheel with a luminous blush resin hub. A gently bent Z profile, mechanically coherent, clearly expresses an adjustable standing posture. The two large hinge discs have beautiful concentric pale-pink optical-resin faces. Broad simple forms, no tiny fasteners, no exposed cables, no added robot body. The entire leg and wheel remain visible in frame. This is a decorative functional illustration, not a technical diagram. Delicate studio reflections, clear material thickness, subtle contact shadow that fades completely into transparent alpha.

Render as a cutout, genuinely transparent background, soft clean antialiased boundary. No plinth, no rectangle, no floor horizon, no card border, no text, no arrows or angle numerals, no logos, no watermark, no neon, no sparkles. One single coherent RGBA image, not a collage.

Use case: stylized-concept.

Reference image 2: companion joystick artwork; match its high-end optical resin, satin white ceramic, broad softbox lighting, generous roundovers and simple readable construction.
Primary subject: a compact elegant gyroscope sensor sculpture, a single luminous lavender translucent sphere held inside two substantial intersecting circular gimbal rings, with a small pearl-white ceramic pivot support beneath. One ring is satin white with a translucent violet edge; the other is lavender optical resin. A faint soft reflection inside the sphere suggests a sensor core. Three-quarter view, precise balanced geometry, solid material thickness, enough negative space between the rings to read cleanly at small size. A tasteful physical metaphor for IMU orientation and diagnostics; no live readings or warning symbols. Calm, tactile, friendly industrial sophistication. Slight lilac to periwinkle variation, restrained highlights, soft ambient occlusion and subtle diffused shadow. Avoid technical clutter, wires, screws, complex electronics, chrome, sparkles, neon and black glass.
Square composition. The complete sphere and rings fit within the upper 68% of canvas, centered horizontally at about 70% width, with generous margins and the lower quarter empty transparent for UI text. Transparent alpha background; no opaque background, no floor horizon, no pedestal block, no border or frame, no text, no numerals, no logo, no watermark. Shadows fade fully to alpha. One high-resolution RGBA image, not a collage or a UI screenshot.
